parts.html: The K-06 kitchen model offers a clean, minimalist furniture solution designed around a bright white color palette, streamlined cabinetry, and practical everyday functionality.

Its single-wall configuration creates an organized kitchen environment while preserving valuable floor space. This makes the model suitable for contemporary apartments, compact residential interiors, and open-plan kitchen-living areas.
The coordinated white finish gives the kitchen a visually light appearance and allows it to complement a variety of interior materials, flooring finishes, and decorative elements.

One of the defining features of the K-06 model is its combination of cabinet front materials. The upper cabinets feature foil-wrapped fronts, while the lower cabinets are manufactured using acrylic-faced MDF panels.
This combination creates a cohesive furniture composition while introducing different surface finishes within the same minimalist design.
The countertop is made from a chipboard-based material, and the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
With a total linear length of 4.4 meters, the K-06 kitchen provides space for built-in appliances, food preparation, and cabinet storage without requiring a separate kitchen island.
A pull-out cargo storage system helps organize kitchen essentials and makes efficient use of available cabinet space.
For comfortable everyday operation, the model includes Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and Muller Box Profi Line drawer systems.
Furniture handles are included in the configuration.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-06 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance requirements, storage preferences, and architectural features.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
